## Scope

Describe the problem, the bounded change, and any behavior intentionally left unchanged.

## Evidence

- [ ] Added or updated synthetic tests.
- [ ] `uv lock --check`
- [ ] Ruff check and format check
- [ ] MyPy
- [ ] pytest
- [ ] No raw/processed data, controlled artifacts, caches, models, logs, or private paths added.
- [ ] Public documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` updated when behavior changed.

## Research boundary

- [ ] No frozen artifact was rewritten.
- [ ] No Test access or formal run occurred unless a permanent, hash-bound approval explicitly
      authorized it.
- [ ] Scientific claims remain inside the approved protocol and evidence boundary.

## Unresolved risks

List compatibility, data, licensing, reproducibility, or interpretation risks that remain.
